title: wg: protocol-06 §5.2 roomId conditional but not optional
description: Suggestion. KeyMaterialRequest (L1133) has a bare "IdentifierUri roomId;" but §5.2 (L1068-1072) requires the room only when adding to a room; the consent struct (L2266) uses optional<RoomId> for the same idea. mimid treats zero-length as absent (decision mimid-1wgh.5.27). Fix: optional<IdentifierUri>.
notes:
Related open issue ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol#149 asks only for extensibility.

Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED technical: roomId should be optional (wire change). New issue cross-ref mimi-protocol#149.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/149#issuecomment-6253615991
